verdict.rationale: Kling's own homepage names an official "MCP / CLI" offering so agents can drive Kling, which is direct first-party evidence that a CLI exists. That is the only mention: there is no CLI documentation, command reference, install path or hands-on corroboration. The other agent and API material (REST API, in-app Agent) describes adjacent features and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: CLI documentation (install, commands, auth), evidence of agent-friendly features like structured output or scripting, independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI exists and works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: MCP / CLI Let Your Agent Power Kling, Turn Ideas into Videos at Scale
